newsitem.title: MALI: Mali's president visits Algeria, Libya.
newsitem.headline: Mali's president visits Algeria, Libya.

text.p: Mali's President Alpha Oumar Konare left Bamako on Wednesday for official visits to Algeria and Libya, officials said.
He was scheduled to go first to Algeria for bilateral talks with President Liamine Zeroual before going on to Libya for his fourth official visit.

Libya's prime minister, Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud visited Mali last month and praised Mali's diplomatic efforts to try to end a United Nations embargo on Libya for alleged involvement in international terrorism.
